test_case.objective: Verify an invalid-JWT checkout with a manipulated total causes no success side effects and does not prevent a later valid checkout of the same cart.
preconditions: User A has a populated cart
Prepare invalid and valid JWT fixtures

request.auth_profile: Bearer fixtures specified by the sequence
request.sequence_or_body_variation: Step 1 uses invalid JWT and low total; step 2 uses valid JWT against the unchanged cart

test_data.description: cart total=known positive; first client total=1; second body remains untrusted
test_data.secret_policy: Use disposable isolated fixtures; no real secrets.

test_case.expected_business_result: Step 1 cannot be an authenticated checkout; step 2 uses the backend cart-derived total.

preconditions: Users A and B have different populated carts

test_case.title: Current-cart authority under stale cross-user collision
test_case.objective: Verify checkout uses authenticated user A's current cart after that cart changes, even when the payload claims user B and supplies a stale total that also equals cart B's total.
preconditions: Users A and B have different populated carts
Cart A changes from total T-old to T-current immediately before checkout
Cart B total equals T-old and differs from T-current

request.auth_profile: Bearer JWT A; use disposable two-user cart fixtures
request.sequence_or_body_variation: Capture T-old for cart A, mutate cart A to T-current, then send checkout with JWT A, unexpected user_id=B, and total_amount=T-old

test_data.description: T-current differs from T-old; cart B total equals T-old; disposable two-user carts
test_data.secret_policy: Use disposable isolated fixtures; no real secrets.

test_case.expected_business_result: On confirmed success, checkout derives the amount from current cart A, not the stale client value, spoofed user ID, or cart B.
test_case.expected_state: Only cart A is cleared after confirmed success; cart B remains unchanged.
test_case.why_ai_missed: Raw AI generation decomposed temporal cart recalculation and cross-user identity isolation into separate cases, so it did not exercise all three competing authorities—current cart A, spoofed user B, and stale client total—in one stateful request.
